summary: The comic-based supernatural shooter series; preserve the first game on seventh-generation console hardware, then use PC for the sequel's highest-fidelity route.

entries.title: The Darkness

emulation.notes: Original console hardware remains the reliable route; PS3/RPCS3 is an alternate platform route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Xbox 360 or accurate seventh-generation console emulation

primary.why: The first game was released only on Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3; no PC or modern remaster exists, and no exclusive content on PS3 is known.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 release on original hardware or an accurate Xbox 360 preservation setup; use PS3 only as an equivalent console alternative.

all_releases.reason: primary: chosen console-preservation route; no PC release or sourced PS3-exclusive content is documented.
skip: same documented core game/platform generation, with no exclusive content requiring a secondary playthrough.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No exclusive content differences between the two console releases are known.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC release or modern remaster is known to exist.

primary.why: The sequel shipped on Windows, PS3, Xbox 360, and Mac; PC has the highest fidelity ceiling and includes the single-player campaign plus Vendettas co-op content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version with modern resolution/settings; use console versions only if PC ownership is unavailable.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the highest graphics/settings ceiling.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity route and full documented campaign/co-op package.
skip: lower fidelity than PC and no exclusive content documented.
skip: lower fidelity than PC and no exclusive content documented.
skip: useful alternate computer route, but Windows PC is the primary fidelity target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is both the fidelity and complete-content recommendation.
